```{r tab-econ-params}
ep_row <- function(r) c(fmt_pct(r$ep$disc_rate), r$dby, fmt_usd(r$ep$gni_pc_base), r$ep$gni_pc_base_year,
                        r$ep$vsl_mult, fmt_usd(r$vsl_b), fmt_pct(r$ep$gdp_growth, 1), r$ep$dalys_per_death,
                        fmt_usd(r$ep$cost_screen_per_person, 2), fmt_usd(r$ep$cost_sap_per_year), fmt_usd(r$ep$cost_surgery))
ep_tab <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Discount rate", "Discount base year", "GNI per capita, Atlas method (VSL anchor)", "GNI / VSL anchor year",
                "VSL multiple of GNI per capita", "VSL in the anchor year", "Real GDP per capita growth (carries VSL)",
                "DALYs per RHD death", "Cost per screening encounter", "Cost per person-year on SAP", "Cost per surgery"),
  Indonesia = ep_row(I), Uganda = ep_row(U))
kb(ep_tab, "lrr", widths = c("6cm", "2.8cm", "2.8cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline As saved with the economic results. GNI: World Bank WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.CD, current US\$ of the anchor year. DALY: disability-adjusted life year (deaths only, no years lived with disability).

## Cost-effectiveness outputs exist but mix discounted and undiscounted terms

```{r tab-econ-detail}
vy0 <- function(r) r$inc[year == Y0, vsl]
pc <- function(r) { x <- merge(r$inc[, .(year, inc_cost)], r$agg[scenario == "ref", .(year, pop)], by = "year"); x[, mean(inc_cost / pop)] }
ed_tab <- data.frame(
  q = c("Cost per death averted", "Cost per DALY averted", paste0("VSL in ", Y0, " (saved)"),
        "Mean annual incremental cost per person (deck-only)"),
  i = c(fmt_usd(I$es$cost_per_death), fmt_usd(I$es$cost_per_daly), fmt_usd(vy0(I)), fmt_usd(pc(I), 2)),
  u = c(fmt_usd(U$es$cost_per_death), fmt_usd(U$es$cost_per_daly), fmt_usd(vy0(U)), fmt_usd(pc(U), 2)))
names(ed_tab) <- c(paste0(Y0, "–", Y1), "Indonesia", "Uganda")
kb(ed_tab, "lrr", widths = c("7cm", "2.5cm", "2.5cm"), font = 9)
```

\srcline Cost per death: discounted cost / undiscounted deaths averted. Cost per DALY: discounted cost / (discounted deaths averted $\times$ `r I$ep$dalys_per_death`). Per-person cost: undiscounted incremental cost / population, averaged over years.

```{r budget-prep, include=FALSE}
bdg <- lapply(COUNTRIES, function(ct) as.data.table(D[[ct]]$econ$budget_impact)); names(bdg) <- COUNTRIES
pk <- vapply(bdg, function(b) b[which.max(incremental), year], 0L)
```

## Annual incremental cost peaks in `r pk[["Indonesia"]]` (Indonesia) and `r pk[["Uganda"]]` (Uganda); the scale-up ramp ends in `r YE`

```{r tab-budget}
yrs_b <- intersect(seq(2030, Y1, by = 10), I$yy)
bt <- function(ct) { b <- bdg[[ct]][year %in% yrs_b]
  list(ref = fmt_mn(b$cost_ref), sap = fmt_mn(b$cost_sap), inc = fmt_mn(b$incremental)) }
bi <- bt("Indonesia"); bu <- bt("Uganda")
bud <- data.frame(Year = yrs_b, a = bi$ref, b = bi$sap, c = bi$inc, d = bu$ref, e = bu$sap, f = bu$inc)
names(bud) <- c("Year", "Reference", "Scale-up", "Increment", "Reference", "Scale-up", "Increment")
kb(bud, "lrrrrrr", font = 9) |> add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Indonesia, US$ m" = 3, "Uganda, US$ m" = 3))
```

\srcline Undiscounted annual programme cost by arm (screening + SAP + surgery), selected years.

```{r abstract-prep, include=FALSE}
abs_p <- file.path(ROOT, "dev", "Abstract WCRHD26 DW_NM.docx")
ABS <- NULL
if (file.exists(abs_p)) {
  td <- tempfile("abs"); dir.create(td)
  xml <- utils::unzip(abs_p, files = "word/document.xml", exdir = td)
  txt <- gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("<[^>]+>", "", paste(readLines(xml, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = " ")))
  grab <- function(re) { m <- regmatches(txt, regexec(re, txt))[[1]]; if (length(m) == 3) m[2:3] else c("n/a", "n/a") }
  ABS <- list(deaths = grab("avert ([0-9,]+) and ([0-9,]+) RHD deaths"),
              red = grab("representing a ([0-9]+)% and ([0-9]+)% reduction"),
              bcr = grab("ratios of ([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+) and ([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)"))
  unlink(td, recursive = TRUE)
}
av <- function(i) if (is.null(ABS)) c("n/a", "n/a") else ABS[[i]]
n_match <- if (is.null(ABS)) NA_integer_ else
  sum(c(av("deaths")[1] == fmt_h(U$t50$da), av("bcr")[1] == fmt_f(U$t50$ben / U$t50$cost),
        av("deaths")[2] == fmt_h(I$t50$da), av("bcr")[2] == fmt_f(I$t50$ben / I$t50$cost)))
```

## `r if (is.na(n_match)) "The submitted abstract was not available at render time" else if (n_match == 0) "The submitted abstract predates the current specification; truncated saved runs no longer reproduce it" else paste0("Truncated saved runs reproduce ", n_match, " of the abstract's four death and ratio figures")`

```{r tab-abstract}
abs_tab <- data.frame(
  q = c(paste("RHD deaths averted by", YE), paste("Death-rate reduction in", YE), "Benefit–cost ratio"),
  ua = c(av("deaths")[1], paste0(av("red")[1], "\\%"), av("bcr")[1]),
  us = c(fmt_h(U$t50$da), fmt_pct(U$rate_red_ye), fmt_f(U$t50$ben / U$t50$cost)),
  ia = c(av("deaths")[2], paste0(av("red")[2], "\\%"), av("bcr")[2]),
  is = c(fmt_h(I$t50$da), fmt_pct(I$rate_red_ye), fmt_f(I$t50$ben / I$t50$cost)))
names(abs_tab) <- c("", "Abstract", "Saved run", "Abstract", "Saved run")
kb(abs_tab, "lrrrr", widths = c("3.9cm", "1.95cm", "1.95cm", "1.95cm", "1.95cm"), font = 9) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Uganda (low-income illustration)" = 2, "Indonesia (upper-middle-income)" = 2))
```

\srcline Abstract values parsed from the submitted WCRHD 2026 abstract, which presented hypothetical countries from earlier runs. Saved-run values are sums to `r YE` of the current saved outputs.

## No sensitivity analysis exists yet; these analyses are planned

- **Probabilistic:** sample transitions, stage-D mortality and incidence multipliers within prior ranges
- **One-way:** SAP hazard ratios and C$\rightarrow$D effect; adherence below one; VSL multiple and GNI anchor year; discount rate; screening ages and frequencies; unit costs
- **Calibration:** prevalence : death weight ratio; structural prior weight; death-target age floor; target basis
- **Structural:** all-stage mortality comparator; direct-mortality SAP comparator; surgery returning patients to C

\srcline The pipeline is deterministic; none of the results in this deck carry uncertainty intervals.

```{r discrepancies-prep, include=FALSE}
# Discrepancy log. The configuration script is read as text, never sourced.
cfg <- tryCatch(readLines(file.path(ROOT, "scripts", "00_run_all.R"), warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
i_tr <- grep("^incidence_trend <- switch\\(COUNTRY", cfg)
cfg_tr <- if (length(i_tr)) sub(".*Indonesia = ([0-9.]+).*", "\\1",
                                grep("Indonesia =", cfg[i_tr:(i_tr + 3)], value = TRUE)[1]) else "not parsed"
uga_old <- sub(".*UGA ~([0-9,]+).*", "\\1", grep("UGA ~[0-9]", cfg, value = TRUE)[1])
anchor_comment <- any(grepl("CF is the RHD-mortality", cfg))
vt <- tryCatch(readLines(file.path(ROOT, "tests", "verify_abcd_pipeline.R"), warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
old_scr_test <- any(grepl("n_screened == population x screening coverage", vt, fixed = TRUE))
DIS <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Indonesia incidence trend", "Uganda GDP per capita", "State diagram", "Layer-1 role in comments",
           "Seed stage split comment", "Diagnosis cost", "Screening check in tests"),
  Detail = c(paste0("Saved run ", fmt_f(I$trend, 3), "; scripts/00\\_run\\_all.R ", cfg_tr,
                    if (identical(cfg_tr, fmt_f(I$trend, 3))) " (consistent)" else " (differs)"),
             paste0("Growth-index level ", fmt_usd(U$ep$gdp_pc_base), "; World Bank 2019 is about US\\$", uga_old,
                    ". The level cancels in VSL, which now uses GNI"),
             "docs/ PNG shows SAP on stage mortality and other-cause death from A only; deck draws its own",
             if (anchor_comment) "00 block F says Layer-1 CF anchors Layer 2; 04b uses Layer-1 $\\alpha$ only as starts" else "Consistent with 04b",
             "03 still documents a Cannon split; 05 seeds the 04b bridged state",
             "Volumes tracked in 06; no unit cost in 08",
             if (old_scr_test) "tests/verify\\_abcd\\_pipeline.R check 12 still expects whole-population screening" else "Consistent with 06"),
  Action = c(if (identical(cfg_tr, fmt_f(I$trend, 3))) "None" else "Re-run Indonesia", "Confirm source", "Redraw",
             if (anchor_comment) "Update comments" else "None", "Update comments", "Decide",
             if (old_scr_test) "Update test" else "None"))
N_DIS <- c("One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine")[nrow(DIS)]
```

## Provenance (1/2): calibration, validation and health results trace to saved objects

```{r tab-prov-1}
pv1 <- data.frame(
  Result = c("Fit, statuses", "Parameters, priors", "Identifiability", "Validation", "Deaths averted", "Stage stocks, flows"),
  Script = c("04b", "04b", "04b", "01, 02, 06", "06", "06"),
  Artifact = c("data/<C>/calibrated\\_rhd\\_parameters.rds", "same", "same",
               "data/<C>/temp\\_baseline\\_rates\\_gbd.rds; pop\\_observed.rds; output/<C>/out\\_model/<C>.rds",
               "output/<C>/out\\_model/<C>.rds", "same"),
  Object = c("\\$stage\\_calibration\\$fit\\_by\\_group\\_year, \\$statuses", "\\$stage\\_calibration\\$parameters, \\$priors, \\$bounds",
             "\\$stage\\_calibration\\$identifiability", "GBD Rate; Nx; \\$wsd, \\$stages (ref)", "\\$wsd\\$dead", "\\$stages A--D, flows"),
  Shape = c("cells by age group, sex, year", paste(nrow(I$ptab), "rows"), paste(nrow(I$ident), "rows"), "age $\\times$ sex $\\times$ year",
            paste0("101 ages $\\times$ 2 sexes $\\times$ ", length(I$yy), " years $\\times$ 2 arms"), "same; persons"),
  Transform = c("sums; ratios", "back-transformed bounds", "none", "rate $\\times$ population; sums", "ref $-$ sap; cumulative",
                "sums; percent difference"))
brk <- function(x) gsub("\\\\_", "\\\\_\\\\allowbreak{}", gsub("/", "/\\\\allowbreak{}", x))
pv1$Artifact <- brk(pv1$Artifact); pv1$Object <- brk(pv1$Object)
kb(pv1, "llllll", widths = c("1.8cm", "0.9cm", "2.9cm", "2.4cm", "1.7cm", "1.6cm"), font = 7)
```

## Rendering needs only the saved artifacts, R and a XeLaTeX toolchain

- Render: `rmarkdown::render("reports/slideck-technical.Rmd")` with XeLaTeX and Calibri; set `RHD_REPO_ROOT` when rendering a copy outside the repository
- Inputs: artifacts of scripts 01–08 for both countries; a missing file stops the render and names its producing script
- Checks: location, scenarios, years, specification, calibrated parameters, seed, reference care, SAP trace and economics agree for each country
- Software: `r R.version.string`; rmarkdown `r packageVersion("rmarkdown")`; knitr `r packageVersion("knitr")`; data.table `r packageVersion("data.table")`; ggplot2 `r packageVersion("ggplot2")`; kableExtra `r packageVersion("kableExtra")`
- Saved: calibration `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "data", "Indonesia", "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` / `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "data", "Uganda", "calibrated_rhd_parameters.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")`; model outputs `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "output", "Indonesia", "out_model", "Indonesia.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` / `r format(file.mtime(file.path(ROOT, "output", "Uganda", "out_model", "Uganda.rds")), "%Y-%m-%d")` (Indonesia / Uganda)
